get.description: Read a page of CRM objects of a specified type. You can control the data returned by using the `properties` query parameter to specify which object properties to include. This endpoint supports pagination and allows you to retrieve associated IDs for specified object types.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

parameters.name: associations
parameters.description: A comma separated list of object types to retrieve associated IDs for. If any of the specified associations do not exist, they will be ignored.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned in the response. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

parameters.name: propertiesWithHistory
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned along with their history of previous values. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored. Usage of this parameter will reduce the maximum number of objects that can be read by a single request.

createdAt.description: The date and time when this object was created, in ISO 8601 format.

id.description: The unique identifier for this CRM object.

objectWriteTraceId.description: An identifier used for tracing the write operations related to this object.

sourceId.description: An identifier for the source of the value. This is a string.

sourceType.description: The type of source from which the value originated. This is a string.

timestamp.description: The date and time when the value was recorded, in ISO 8601 format.

updatedByUserId.description: The ID of the user who last updated this value. This is an integer.

value.description: The actual value being recorded. This is a string.

propertiesWithHistory.description: A map of property names to arrays of past values, each with a timestamp indicating when the value was set.

updatedAt.description: The date and time when this object was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

url.description: The URL link to this object.

warnings.description: An array of warnings related to this object, each containing a category, message, and context.

category.description: A string representing the category of the warning.

context.description: An object providing additional context for the warning, with properties as key-value pairs.

message.description: A string containing the warning message.

items.description: Represents a warning message related to a public object in HubSpot, providing details about the nature and context of the warning.

get.description: List all associations of an object by object type. This endpoint allows you to retrieve associations for a specified object, identified by its type and ID, to another object type. The maximum number of associations returned per call is limited to 500.

parameters.name: toObjectType
parameters.description: The type of the object to which associations are being listed.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

after.description: A string token used as a cursor to fetch the next set of results in a paginated response.

link.description: A URL string that points to the next page of results in the paginated response.

next.description: Specifies the paging information needed to retrieve the next set of results in a paginated API response

paging.description: Paging information for forward-only pagination. Contains the next page reference when more results are available; omitted or empty on the last page.

results.description: An array of objects, each representing an association with multiple labels. Each object includes details about the associated object and its labels.

associationTypes.description: An array of association specifications with labels, detailing the types of associations and their respective labels.

category.description: The category of the association. Valid values include 'HUBSPOT_DEFINED', 'USER_DEFINED', 'INTEGRATOR_DEFINED', and 'WORK'.

fromObjectTypeId.description: A string representing the object type ID from which the association originates.

label.description: A string representing the label associated with the association.

toObjectTypeId.description: A string representing the object type ID to which the association points.

typeId.description: An integer representing the unique identifier for the type of association.

items.description: Defines the type, direction, and details of the relationship between two CRM objects.

toObjectId.description: The unique identifier of the object to which associations are being made. This is a string value.

items.description: Represents an object that is associated with multiple other objects, with optional context.

schema.description: Represents a paginated collection of objects that are associated with multiple labels, including the results and pagination details. This component is used when retrieving associated objects with specific labels in a forward-paging manner.
